content: {"episode_id":"ep-05093","cpt":"93229","denial_carc":"CO-50","necessity_paragraph":"Reconsideration is requested for the CO-50 medical necessity denial of mobile cardiac telemetry (CPT 93229). The clinical indication note documents intermittent palpitations and a sensation of irregular heartbeat, concerning for arrhythmia in the context of known nonrheumatic mitral valve insufficiency. Mobile cardiac telemetry was ordered to capture and correlate these symptomatic episodes with underlying rhythm disturbances over an extended monitoring period."}
